raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer surfaced and implicitly treated an incorrect biographical result for “Kim Dae-hwan (director)” showing “Born: 1933” (likely a different person with the same name), failing to properly disambiguate the End of Winter filmmaker. This misidentification would lead to the wrong conclusion that End of Winter’s director is older, whereas the correct comparison (Pawel Pawlikowski, 1957, vs. Kim Dae-hwan, b. mid-1980s) shows The Woman in the Fifth has the older director.
